title: Drawing partially disappeared - possible data loss bug
body:
Device: iPhone 12 mini
Date: August 8, 2026
Time: approximately 22:25
I was drawing in Apple Notes when my drawing suddenly disappeared while I was adding a normal new stroke. I did not use the eraser or intentionally delete any part of the drawing.
The drawing represented approximately four hours of work. After the incident, almost the entire previous drawing was gone, but the last stroke I was making immediately before the disappearance was still present.
Undo did not restore the missing drawing. I closed and reopened Notes, but the previous drawing was still missing.
Because the most recent stroke remained while the earlier drawing disappeared, this seems like a possible problem with how Notes saved or displayed the drawing data.
Please investigate this as a possible drawing data-loss bug and, if possible, advise whether the missing drawing data can be recovered.
author: ItzUnaOfficial

title: Issues with numbering lists and inability to arbitrarily order notes
body:
Overall, Notes are very good but details prevent it from being much more versatile and productive tool. Like, it’s impossible to order notes and move them around within a gallery as you wish. For example, when I’m working on a script, I like to write scenes individually, each as a separate note. Then, I need to move them around in order arrange the structure of the story but it's unfortunately not possible. Because I like using native Apple apps, I would really want to have this possibility and keep my workflows within Apple ecosystem. 

Another issue that I encountered is with automatically numbered lists. When you paste photos in a list, the numbing just resets and starts from one in the next row. Pretty frustrating when you’re watching a lecture and want to include screenshots or photos. 

And I would mention that “insert drawing” system for using pencil when you just want to scribble something around the text is so cumbersome and claustrophobic.
